headline: Cafelândia House / Ana Sawaia Arquitetura
context: Located in the Sumaré neighborhood of São Paulo, the renovation of Casa Cafelândia reconfigures a 1938 residence to bring its social spaces closer to the garden and adapt the house to a more open, light-filled, and connected way of living.
